resources.string: Never round your lower back; the bar must travel in a straight vertical path.
Take a deep breath and brace before pulling, exhale at the top.
Pulling with the lower back instead of pushing the floor.

string-array.name: ex_g7_1_steps
string-array.item: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the bar over mid-foot.
Push hips back to grip the bar, open your chest, and lock your back flat.
Drive through your feet keeping the bar close to your legs until lockout.

resources.string: Tuck your chin slightly toward your chest to prevent lower back hyperextension.

string-array.name: ex_g7_2_steps
string-array.item: Rest your shoulder blades on a bench with the barbell across your hip crease.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until parallel and squeeze hard at the top.

resources.string: Keep your hips pressed flat into the pad.
Dropping the weight down too fast.

string-array.name: ex_g7_3_steps
string-array.item: Lie face down on the machine with the pad just above your Achilles tendon.
Curl your heels toward your glutes and lower with control.

resources.string: Lower slowly to prevent torso swing.

string-array.name: ex_g7_4_steps
string-array.item: Hang from a pull-up bar.
Curl your knees smoothly toward your chest.
Lower with control without swinging.

resources.string: Pulling with arms before legs finish pushing.

string-array.name: ex_g8_1_steps
string-array.item: Strap your feet securely.
Push powerfully with your legs first, lean slightly back, then pull handle to chest.

resources.string: Arms are just ropes—power comes completely from your hip snap.
Exhale sharply on the swing up.
Squatting down and lifting with the front delts.

string-array.name: ex_g8_2_steps
string-array.item: Stand wider than shoulder-width.
Hinge at the hips and hike the kettlebell between your legs.
Snap hips forward explosively to swing weight to chest height.

resources.string: Brace your abs tight and keep your chest upright.

string-array.name: ex_g8_3_steps
string-array.item: Take an athletic stance with knees slightly bent.
Whip the ropes alternately in fast continuous waves.

resources.string: Burns high calories with low joint impact.
Leaning on the handles and reducing effort.

string-array.name: ex_g8_4_steps
string-array.item: Walk briskly at 10–12% incline and 5.0–5.5 km/h.
Swing your arms naturally without holding the rails.

resources.string: Keep full muscular tension during the pause.
Inhale at the top, exhale as you press.
Bouncing the bar off your chest.

string-array.name: ex_g9_1_steps
string-array.item: Lower the bar smoothly to your chest.
Pause completely for 1 full second on your chest.
Drive explosively upward.

resources.string: Forward lean shifts focus onto the lower chest.
Rolling shoulders forward at the bottom.

string-array.name: ex_g9_2_steps
string-array.item: Grip parallel bars and lean your torso slightly forward.
Lower until elbows reach 90 degrees, then press strongly up.

resources.string: Sweep in a wide arc to stretch the chest.
Loading too heavy and bending elbows sharply.

string-array.name: ex_g9_3_steps
string-array.item: Adjust seat height and keep elbows slightly bent.
Bring arms together in front and squeeze for 1 second.

resources.string: Squeeze your back on every rep.
Jerking upright with the lower back.

string-array.name: ex_g10_1_steps
string-array.item: Hinge 45 degrees forward with a locked flat back.
Pull the weight toward your lower chest.

resources.string: Deeply stretches and engages the lower lats.

string-array.name: ex_g10_2_steps
string-array.item: Hold a narrow V-bar overhead.
Keep elbows tucked to your sides and pull down to upper chest.

resources.string: Lift straight up—do not roll shoulders.

string-array.name: ex_g10_3_steps
string-array.item: Hold heavy dumbbells at your sides.
Elevate shoulders straight toward your ears and hold 1 second.

resources.string: Don\'t let your knees cave inward.

string-array.name: ex_g11_1_steps
string-array.item: Press your back flat against the pad and place feet slightly forward.
Squat deep and drive up through your heels.

resources.string: Keep torso upright and both knees near 90 degrees.
Exhale as you stand into each step.
Stepping on a narrow tightrope line.

string-array.name: ex_g11_2_steps
string-array.item: Take a long step forward until the rear knee nears the floor.
Drive through the front heel into the next step.

resources.string: Lower slowly to maximize quad tension.
Kicking the weight up with momentum.

string-array.name: ex_g11_3_steps
string-array.item: Position the pad just above your ankles.
Extend legs fully and squeeze for 1 second at the top.

resources.string: Flex through your abs, not by pulling with your arms.
Sitting hips back toward your heels.

string-array.name: ex_g12_1_steps
string-array.item: Kneel before the cable pulley, holding the rope beside your head.
Keep hips fixed and curl ribs toward your knees.

resources.string: Keep slight spinal flexion to maintain ab tension.
Pulling on the neck with your hands.

string-array.name: ex_g12_2_steps
string-array.item: Anchor feet under the decline bench pads.
Lower and rise smoothly with core tension.

resources.string: Letting your shoulders rotate toward the cable.

string-array.name: ex_g12_3_steps
string-array.item: Stand sideways to a cable machine holding the handle at chest height.
Press arms straight forward and resist the cable\'s pull to twist.

resources.string: One of the safest hypertrophy techniques for upper chest.

string-array.name: ex_gp1_1_steps
string-array.item: Align the bar over your upper chest on a 30-degree incline bench.
Lower for 3 seconds, pause 1 second, press explosively.

resources.string: Supersets double muscular blood flow and pump.
Taking long rests between the two exercises.

string-array.name: ex_gp1_2_steps
string-array.item: Immediately perform cable flyes right after finishing your dips.
Fully stretch and squeeze your chest fibers.

resources.string: Maximally recruits the lateral deltoid head.

string-array.name: ex_gp1_3_steps
string-array.item: Do 12 reps with your starting weight, immediately drop weight for 10 reps, then drop again for 10 more.

resources.string: Depress your shoulder blades before initiating the pull.
Kicking your legs to swing upward.

string-array.name: ex_gp2_1_steps
string-array.item: Hang with a wide overhand grip.
Pull your chest toward the bar until your chin clears it.

resources.string: Lifting your chest off the bench.

string-array.name: ex_gp2_2_steps
string-array.item: Lie chest-down on an incline bench.
Row cleanly with zero lower-back momentum.

resources.string: Snapping elbows into full lockout at the bottom.

string-array.name: ex_gp2_3_steps
string-array.item: Do 10 reps on the preacher bench, then move straight to cable rope hammer curls.

resources.string: If your elbows drop, your torso will pitch forward.
Straining the wrists instead of resting on delts.

string-array.name: ex_gp3_1_steps
string-array.item: Rest the barbell across your front delts with elbows pointed high.
Squat deep with an upright torso and drive explosively up.

string-array.name: ex_gp3_2_steps
string-array.item: Place your rear foot\'s laces on a bench behind you.
Lower down with control and drive up through the front leg.

resources.string: Land quietly like a cat to protect joints.
Jumping backwards off the box (step down instead).

string-array.name: ex_gp3_3_steps
string-array.item: Set an athletic stance facing the plyo box.
Swing arms and jump softly onto the center of the box.

string-array.name: ex_gp4_1_steps
string-array.item: Activate major lower-body muscles with deep controlled squat technique.

resources.string: Pin shoulder blades firmly to the bench.
Lowering the bar toward your neck.

string-array.name: ex_gp4_2_steps
string-array.item: Lower the bar just below your collarbone and press powerfully up.

resources.string: Builds raw back thickness and athletic power.

string-array.name: ex_gp4_3_steps
string-array.item: With torso parallel to the floor, pull explosively from a dead stop each rep.

resources.string: Breathe steadily rather than shallow gasps.

string-array.name: ex_gp4_4_steps
string-array.item: Hold heavy dumbbells at your sides, pull shoulders back, and walk briskly.
